name: Kan'ochi x Namaiki Gyaru ~Chou Kimochi Ii! Atashi, Sensei no Niku Onaho ni Naru!~
original_name: 完堕ち×生意気ギャル ～チョー気持ちイイ！アタシ、センセイの肉オナホになるっ！～
source:
“Dammit! Let me go! Get off me!!”
—Private Reisou Academy.
Deep beneath the school lies a reform facility for problematic students who are too much for regular teachers to handle. Rarely used, the facility is managed by Inahara Yoshito, the school’s health teacher.
This time, the target is Shirakawa Erina, the daughter of a wealthy real estate tycoon.
Erina is what you’d call a “gal”—a spoiled rich girl who’s been running wild at the academy, thanks to her parents’ hefty donations. But her behavior has escalated to the point where even the staff can’t ignore it anymore. Finally, the principal orders Yoshito to “reform” her.
“Now, now, Erina… calm down. Here, why don’t you take a whiff of this aroma to relax?”
“Who the hell would—?! Stop it! Aaaaaah!!!”
Yoshito uses a special concoction of his own making to cloud his target’s mind, making them suggestible and… responsive. Smirking at the now-subdued Erina, he begins his work.
“Heh heh… much better. Now, let’s start with…”
With the help of his assistant, Suwa Seika, Yoshito has “reformed” countless problematic students in the past. And now, it’s Erina’s turn to fall into his trap.

translation:
“可恶！放开我！放开我！！”
——私立灵草学园。
学校的深处有一个改造设施，专门为那些普通老师无法处理的问题学生而设。该设施很少使用，由学校的健康老师稻原义人管理。
这次的目标是房地产大亨的女儿白川惠里奈。
惠里娜就是所谓的“gal”——一个被宠坏的富家女，在父母的巨额捐款的帮助下，在学院里肆意妄为。但她的行为已经升级到连工作人员都无法再忽视的地步。最后，校长命令义人“改造”她。
“好了好了，绘里奈……冷静点。来，闻一下这个香气放松一下吧？”
“到底谁会——？！停下来！啊啊啊！！！”
吉人使用他自己制作的一种特殊混合物来迷惑目标的思想，使他们容易受到暗示并且……做出反应。他对着已经被制服的埃里娜傻笑着，开始了他的工作。
“呵呵……好多了。现在，我们开始吧……”
义人在助手诹访清香的帮助下，“改造”了无数问题学生。现在，轮到艾莉娜落入他的陷阱了。
